extraction.benefits_span: keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?
extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

superlatives.text: keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?

composition.coaching_note: The agent could improve by not using superlatives that may be considered misleading, such as 'keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?'
composition.summary: The agent delivered the TPMO disclaimer before discussing benefits and collected the Scope of Appointment before scheduling an appointment. The agent discussed a Cigna MA plan with a $40 monthly premium and a $20 drug deductible.
